patterns.note: Alternating full-bleed dark and light sections create distinct visual breaks and content zones as the user scrolls down the page.
A dramatic contrast in typography is used, pairing a very large, bold sans-serif for primary headings with an elegant, flowing script font for key words to add sophistication and visual interest.
A high-contrast palette of near-black and bright white dominates, punctuated by a vibrant yellow/lime green for calls to action and accent elements.

Images within the hero section parallax at a faster rate than the main text, creating a dynamic depth effect as the user scrolls. Subsequent content sections transition into view with a full-height reveal, replacing the previous section.
The hero section features a large, impactful statement with asymmetrical, dynamic imagery of diverse individuals, setting an emotional and inclusive tone.

technique_notes: The navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling. The hero section employs a parallax effect where background images move at a different speed than the foreground text, enhancing depth. Subsequent content sections are designed as full-viewport height blocks that slide into view sequentially, replacing the previous section entirely, creating a distinct 'page-turn' feel. This motion system is likely orchestrated using a scroll-triggered animation library like locomotive-scroll or GSAP ScrollTrigger, combined with CSS keyframes for specific element animations.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) are paired with an elegant, flowing script font for key emotional words, creating a sophisticated and impactful typographic hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (approx. 8-12px) are consistently applied to buttons, cards, and image containers, providing a soft, modern touch.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero and between major sections, transitioning to a balanced density within content cards and a denser layout in the footer.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, high-contrast black and white aesthetic, combined with a dynamic, asymmetrical image layout and the unexpected use of an elegant script font for emphasis in the hero. This creates a sophisticated, almost editorial feel that elevates it beyond a typical financial services site, making it feel more like a lifestyle brand.
